product.ta-bitsy-30.summary: The BITSY 30 was the multi-station option with higher-capacity magnetic disks.
product.ta-bitsy-30.history: The 1982 handbook places it at the expandable end of the word-processing range and lists up to 16 screen stations and printers.
product.ta-bitsy-30.technical.configurat: Fixed and removable disks expanded shared storage. The handbook describes 2 × 8 MB and 2 × 16 MB options.
product.ta-bitsy-30.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-bitsy-30.technical.limitation: The boot ROM and a working-system test remain pending.
